children: Nvidia's ability to sustain its pace of AI product development without CEO Jensen Huang could become an indicator of the industry's future direction, says TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo. Huang's unique value lies not in his technical expertise alone, but in his ability to quickly align strategy, technology, organizational resources and supply chains behind ambitious product decisions, Kuo says. That leadership has given suppliers the confidence to invest and adapt to aggressive specification upgrades while pushing rivals to follow suit. If Huang emerges weakened by the ongoing controversy, Nvidia may need to gradually reduce its dependence on his personal decision-making and prepare a succession plan, Kuo adds.(megumi.fujikawa@wsj.com)
